parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json,s=$('Select QA Source Tab').first().json,values=input.values??[];if(!s.enrichmentSkipped||values.length<2)return [{json:input}];const norm=v=>String(v??'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,''),headers=values[0]??[],statusIndex=headers.map(norm).findIndex(h=>['verificationstatus','status','providerstatus'].includes(h));if(statusIndex<0)throw new Error('Verified Leads must contain Verification Status before QA can use the skipped-enrichment path.');const goodRows=values.slice(1).filter(row=>norm(row?.[statusIndex])==='good');if(!goodRows.length)throw new Error('Verified Leads contains no Good campaign-ready rows for QA.');return [{json:{...input,values:[headers,...goodRows]}}];
